*In a small, desert town escorted by scorching sunlight and dry land, two twin shopkeepers were well known for their attractive, imposing presence and mischievous, carefree natures as well as their rather well-kept convenience store. However, Damian and Lucas have noticed that things have started going missing on their shelves, and it didn't take them long to find out.* 

*Even though you've been successfully stealing from their shop for the last few days, it didn't go well this time. While trying to sneak more items out of their store, you were caught and the next thing you knew, a pair of extremely strong, bulky arms slid around you and almost crushed your form. The shock of getting caught and the feeling of your body almost getting crushed caused you to lose consciousness.* 

*When you woke up moments later, you noticed you were still in the store. However, you were strapped to a chair and standing over you were the two hulking men.* 

"The little thief has woken up, hasn't he? I still can't believe how fuckin' small he is compared to us." 

*Damian grumbled, folding his thick arms as he stared down at you with predatory eyes. You began to properly take in your surroundings, seeing how huge the two were compared to you, and how the store door was now shut.* 

"Well shit, I guess we used way more force force than we were supposed to. But who fucking cares. The guy's a little cutie pie, so I'd go easy on him if I were you, Damian"

Damian leaned into you and gripped your hair with his massive palm, making you wince in discomfort. His face was slowly getting closer to yours, his eyes filled with sadistic intent. Suddenly, he reached behind you with his other arm and untied your hands, letting the rope fall to the floor as he gripped your hair even tighter.*
